author: claude-opus
text:
template: scaffold conversation repo under template/

Per ARCH §2.2. Adds template/ with .agent/ (version, providers/agents/
manifest/workflow yamls, system prompts for worker/compactor/base,
empty state + skill/tool dirs) plus top-level exchanges/, artifacts/,
invocations/, tools/ dirs (all gitkept). No goal.md — written at
dispatch (ARCH §2.8).

Tooling: scripts/new-conversation.sh copies the template, runs
git init -b main, and lands an init commit. The script unsets inherited
GIT_DIR/GIT_INDEX_FILE/etc. so it behaves correctly when invoked from a
git-hook context. Wired to a `make new-conversation DEST=<path>` target.
bl-2904 will supersede this with an in-process `lernie new` subcommand.

tests/template.rs invokes the script end-to-end and asserts every
.agent/*.yaml validates against the bl-5bbc schemas, cross-file refs
resolve, referenced prompts exist, version == 1, goal.md is absent,
state files match the documented baseline, and the resulting repo has
exactly one commit. The test scrubs inherited git env vars from every
git subprocess for the same reason.

ARCH §4.3 documents that agents.system_prompt is resolved relative to
.agent/system/ (matches the loader's existing behavior).
